name: Zibra Labs

modes.label: Native product; see regime notes
modes.note: Incomplete or non-resource economics: rates remain null, never interpreted as free.

caveats: Pre-launch / sales-led: official site describes a distributed runtime (built by ex-Ray tech leads) on the cheapest CPUs and GPUs across hyperscalers and neoclouds, using spot instances across regions and providers, 'targeting' 100-50,000 CPU+GPU node clusters. Only CTA is 'Schedule a Call'. No pricing (/pricing 404), no docs, no console, no self-serve signup. Not a sandbox/VM product.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.
Official site says the underlying capacity is spot instances across regions and providers (interruptible).

fleet.notes: Official site asks prospective large-compute customers to schedule a call. Target scale of 100–50,000 nodes is a product ambition, not a fresh-account entitlement. Default quota, verification and review timing unpublished.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages
